newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Horn nominates new health minister.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Horn nominates new health minister.

text.p: Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn on Monday nominated Mihaly Kokely as his new health minister.
Kokely, 46, told the Hungarian news agency MTI he will accept the current 1997 health spending plans which provoked the resignation of his predecessor.
"I believe the debate on next year's health financing has been completed," he said. "I am not bargaining with the prime minister on funding."

The previous health minister Gyorgy Szabo quit last month saying that the funds allocated in the draft 1997 budget fell 11 billion forints ($67 million) short of what was needed to maintain the country's ailing health service.
Kokely, a former cardiologist, is currently state secretary at the health ministry.
